EMPIRICAL INTRAVENOUS REGIMENS WITH VANCOMYCIN
Discontinue vancomycin after 3 days unless culture results indicate that
continued therapy is needed.  Gentamicin is optional.  Contact Hematology-
Oncology or Infectious Diseases for advice.

[References](orzid2-gmenu-abx-references)

Hughes WT Clin Infect Dis 2002, 34: 730
Rolston KVI Clin Infect Dis 2004, 39: S44
Sipsas NV  Cancer 2005, 103: 1103
Therapy:
## Preferred treatment

[Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h \($6/day\) R <AND> cefepime 2 gm IV q8h](orz-set-abx-cefepime-2gm-iv-q8h-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)

($35/DAY) [R]

[Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h \($33/day\) R <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg](orz-set-abx-pip-taz4-5gm-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro-vanco15mg-kg)

IV q12h ($6.00/day) [R] < OR >
[Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h \($33/day\) R <AND> gentamicin 5](orz-set-abx-piper-tz-4-5-gent-5m-kg-vanco-15mg-kg-q12h)

mg/kg IV q24h ($3/day) [R] <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg q12h ($6.00/day) [R]

## Alternatives for penicillin allergy

[Aztreonam 2 gm IV q8h \($50/day\) <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h](orz-set-abx-aztreon-2gm-q8h-vanco-15mg-kg-q12h)

($6/day) [R] < OR >
[Aztreonam 2 gm IV q8h \($50/day\) <AND> gentamicin 5 mg/kg IV q24h \($3/day\)](orz-set-abx-aztreon-2g-q8h-gent-5mg-kg-vanco-15mg-kg-q12h)

[R] <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h ($6.00/day) [R]
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU EMP INTRAV W/ VANCO
ERUC: ORZID GMENU ER/UC EMP INTRAV W/ VANCO
